metadata.title: SpaceX succumbs to gravity as the stock briefly dips below its debut price on Nasdaq - MarketWatch

content.text:
Space Watch
SpaceX succumbs to gravity as the stock briefly dips below its debut price on Nasdaq
The stock hits a new low before recovering to close in positive territory
After setting a record intraday low early in Tuesday’s trading day, SpaceX shares have recovered and climbed back into positive territory.
Shortly after Tuesday’s session began, SpaceX’s stock fell below its opening price on the Nasdaq after its initial public offering on June 11. SpaceX shares SPCX traded as low as $147.11 in early Tuesday action, below that $150 level from the first trading day, though they rebounded to end Tuesday up 1%, to about $156.
